articles.title: Toronto police respond to fire at Scarborough commercial building
articles.summary: Toronto police say they responded to a fire at a commercial building in Scarborough late Tuesday night. Officers were called to the St. Clair Avenue East and Kennedy Road area for reports of a fire at a commercial building. It is not yet known if there are any injuries related to the blaze.

articles.title: Venue shortages and city growth take centre stage at Brampton mayoral town hall
articles.summary: Five candidates vying to lead Brampton took the stage together for the first time in the 2026 municipal election campaign on Tuesday night.

articles.title: TTC Line 1 trains slowing between TMU station and King station as Ontario Line construction continues
articles.summary: TTC riders travelling between TMU and King stations are being warned that Line 1 trains are moving slower than usual due to a “reduced speed zone” as construction continues on the Ontario Line. articles.title: Second Harvest opens Etobicoke food processing facility for school programs
articles.summary: As back-to-school season takes full effect, a Canada-wide organization that rescues surplus food from suppliers and retailers is opening a new food processing facility in Etobicoke for school programs. Second Harvest will take food that would otherwise be bound for landfills, and repurpose into healthy snacks for students.

articles.title: Oshawa funeral home fire was arson, police say
articles.summary: The cause of a fire at Mcintosh-Anderson-Kellam Funeral Home in downtown Oshawa earlier this month was arson, investigators said in an update Tuesday.

articles.title: Wheelchair accessible taxi passenger dead following 2-vehicle crash in Ajax, Ont.: police
articles.summary: Durham police say a 65-year-old man is dead after a wheelchair accessible taxi and another car crashed in Ajax, Ont., Monday.

articles.title: Teen killed in shooting near Jane and Finch remembered as 'young king' with bright future ahead
articles.summary: A 17-year-old boy fatally shot in Toronto on Monday is being remembered as a "young king" whose future has been abruptly taken away by gun violence.

articles.title: It just got way more expensive to rent gyms at Toronto and York Region public schools. Here's why
articles.summary: Some sports groups are slamming Toronto and York Region's public school boards for hiking permit fees on facility rentals like gyms, saying the move could price local groups out of accessing public space for community events.

articles.title: Teen dead after being shot in North York: police
articles.summary: A teen boy is dead after he was shot in North York Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Over 1,000 protesters demonstrate against Carney's investment summit in Toronto, 2 arrested
articles.summary: More than 1,000 demonstrators gathered in downtown Toronto on Monday to protest against an investment summit organized by Prime Minister Mark Carney.

articles.title: Mississauga mayoral race heats up with focus on AI data centres
articles.summary: Mississauga’s mayoral race shifted into high gear this weekend, as four of the leading candidates officially kicked off their campaigns, with the issue of AI data centres taking centre stage.
